summary.text: Arnett Satterla, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Michigan's 1st District to Jack Bergman.
Satterla advanced from the Libertarian convention on June 28, 2026.
Satterla received 0.7% of the vote to Jack Bergman's 53.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
